title: Fried Figs with Greek Twist
description: A sweet and savory dessert that combines the freshness of figs with a classic Greek twist. Perfect for warm weather.
instructions: Cut the figs in half and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with cinnamon, and drizzle with honey.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the figs are tender and caramelized.
Meanwhile, mix the Greek yogurt with vanilla extract in a small bowl.
Serve the yogurt mixture over the warm figs.
Garnish with a sprinkle of cinnamon, if desired.
